lines.text: Colony లో రాజుల యుద్ధం… అసలు రాజు ఎవరో చూడండి!
lines.act: a mock-epic movie-trailer hush, then a cheeky teasing lift
a tiny little-girl voice trying hard to boom like a royal herald, very proud
slow, deep, over-grand royal swagger with a long dramatic pause

a loud, cocky rival-king challenge, puffed-up and theatrical

lines.text: Slow motion war charge… కానీ twist ఇంకా ఉంది!
